facts.fact: CAIDP president Anne-Marie Konan Payne said the access to information law was adopted in 2013 and that the right exists, as reported by 225.ci.
facts.system: loi relative à l'accès à l'information d'intérêt public

facts.fact: 225.ci reports that the 2013 law created the CAIDP as an independent administrative authority, which is chaired by Anne-Marie Konan Payne and has handled requests and appeals.

systems.system: Commission d'Accès à l'Information d'Intérêt Public et aux Documents Publics (CAIDP)
